[SWS_CRYPT_04203] Exporting public objects
⌈
The function ara:-
:crypto::cryp::CryptoProvider::ExportPublicObject shall serialize the
CryptoObject contained in the storage location pointed to by the provided IOInterface.
The function shall return the serialized data as a vector of bytes or
• kEmptyContainer if the underlying resource this IOInterface points to is empty.
• kUnexpectedValue if the underlying resource this IOInterface points contains
a RestrictedUseObject.
• kModifiedResource if this IOInterface points to an instance of a KeySlot that
has been modified after the IOInterface has been opened. ⌋

versions.content:
[SWS_CRYPT_04203] Exporting public objects
⌈
The function ara::crypto::Serializable::ExportPublicly shall serialize
the object in the format specified using the formatId parameter, write the serialized data
into the provided output data buffer, and return the size of the written serialized data. If
the function is a member function of a PublicKey, PrivateKey, or SymmetricKey, it shall
additionally verify prior to serialization that its allowed usage includes kAllowPlain-
textExport and the parameter allowPlainTextExport of the CryptoKeySlot-
ToPortPrototypeMapping from which the object was loaded is configured as True.
⌋
